svg.aria-label: Left, what is given: the keys, each hashed to one slot in each of three consecutive segments and to a short fingerprint, and the lookup, which XORs the three slots. Right, what the agent writes: the construction that fills every slot of the fingerprint array, 16 slots in four segments, so that each key’s three slots XOR to that key’s fingerprint. Key x uses slots holding 3A, 5C and C1, and 3A XOR 5C XOR C1 = A7 = fingerprint(x); key y uses 9E, 14 and 2B, and 9E XOR 14 XOR 2B = A1 = fingerprint(y). A match means present.
svg.text: to one slot in each of
The construction that fills every slot
